scenes.label: Meet Tara
scenes.title: One password, three doors
scenes.caption: Meet Tara. She's growing a floating island garden in her favourite game, Sky Garden. She also uses a school portal for homework, and an email account for class news. To keep things easy, she uses the same password for all three. One key, opening three doors.
scenes.dialogue: My sky garden is almost finished!

scenes.label: The breach
scenes.title: The game got hacked.
scenes.caption: One morning, a message arrives from Sky Garden. The game's website was hacked, and passwords were stolen. This is called a data breach, and it wasn't Tara's fault. But then more alerts pop up. Someone signed in to her school portal. Then her email. Her accounts fall like dominoes.
scenes.dialogue: My school portal too? And my email?

scenes.label: Why it spread
scenes.title: How did it spread?
scenes.caption: Tara shows Mum right away. Mum explains that attackers tried the leaked password on other websites. This is called credential stuffing. Because the same password opened all three, it worked. Together, they use each site's official recovery steps, give every account a new password, and sign out other devices.
scenes.dialogue: Mum, one leak opened all my accounts?

scenes.label: Three keys
scenes.title: Give every door its own key.
scenes.caption: Your turn. Give each account its own passphrase. Pick an account, then tap three word tiles. When all three are ready, replay the breach. If the game leaks again, will the other dominoes stay standing? These are practice words only, never real passwords.

scenes.label: Remember them all
scenes.title: Many keys, one safe place.
scenes.caption: Now a leak can open only one door. But how do you remember so many passphrases? Families often use a password manager, an app that locks them away safely. Or a parent keeps a paper list safe at home. Where sites offer it, Mum also turns on two-step verification: an extra check at sign-in.
scenes.dialogue: Now one leak can't knock them all down.

scenes.label: A happier ending
scenes.title: Back in the sky garden!
scenes.caption: Tara's accounts are back, and her island garden is growing again. Breaches can happen even when you do nothing wrong. Different passwords stop one leak from spreading, and a trusted adult can help you recover. Your turn: help Tara practise giving every account its own key!
scenes.dialogue: Level twenty, and every account has its own key!
